quote: Sometimes the night feels too heavy to hold. You sit alone with thoughts that refuse to quiet down. Every memory returns like a ghost you never invited inside. The silence aches louder than any words ever could. You wonder if anyone even notices the quiet breakdown happening. But deep in the dark, the soul learns how to heal itself.
